reason: The hypothesis directly combines plasma nitriding and PVD TiN coating, a duplex treatment explicitly discussed and proposed as beneficial in P3 and P7. P3 states that nitriding provides a load-bearing diffusion layer that addresses the poor adhesion of PVD coatings on soft Ti6Al4V, which is the exact mechanism and rationale used in the hypothesis. The specific nitriding parameters are taken from P6. The hypothesis therefore restates a known combination and its justification from the literature without introducing a new material, regime, or integrative mechanism.
copied_elements: plasma nitriding of Ti6Al4V at 750 °C for 4 h in NH3-N2 (1:2) atmosphere (P6, P16)
formation of ~2 µm thick Ti-N compound layer (P6)
PVD TiN coating on Ti6Al4V (P3, P7)
nitrided layer as load-bearing support for PVD coating (P3)
improved hardness and wear resistance over untreated alloy (P6, P16, P3)
adhesion issues of PVD on soft substrate (P3)
